name: Summer Speech and Debate Camps (high school)
what_you_do: Debate and speech camps at Augsburg. They cover policy, Lincoln-Douglas, Congress, Public Forum and speech. There is also a workshop on speaking up for a community issue.
who_can_apply: High school students. Beginners and advanced options are listed.
pay_detail: From $425 (1 week debate and argumentation, commuter) up to $2,500 (3 weeks with partial residential). Scholarships available.
duration: 1 to 3 weeks, late June to mid July
deadline_text: 2026 early bird ended March 29; scholarship priority deadline March 1 and last call May 10, 2026. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Register online through the link on the camp page. Aid questions: mnudlcamps@augsburg.edu.
notes: Students on free or reduced lunch with qualifying GPA may get full tuition for the July 6 to 10 week.
